capabilities: Import one note per book with title, author, format, progress, and cover in properties
Download cover images from Readest Cloud or generate local SVG covers
Import highlights as color-aware callouts in page and CFI order
Link highlight titles to the exact annotation in the Readest web reader
Sync on command, on startup, or on an interval while preserving locally edited blocks
extras: Uses Readest's unofficial web sync and storage APIs, which Readest may change. Requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or newer. Sign-in password is not saved; session is stored in Obsidian SecretStorage. Not yet listed in the community plugin directory.
problem: Readest stores highlights and book metadata in its cloud with no way to work with them as ordinary editable Obsidian notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin connects to the Readest web API

summary: Imports a Readest ebook library and highlights into editable Markdown notes with properties, cover images, callouts, and links back to Readest annotations.
